compactRecord.rs: Matsumae Sakura Festival ~20 Apr–10 May; bus from Kikonai Stn (Hokkaidō Shinkansen) ~1 h 30. Combine with the Matsumae-han Yashiki samurai theme park.
compactRecord.td: Hokkaidō's only feudal castle, seat of the Matsumae clan that mediated Edo-era trade with the Ainu. The 1854 hirajiro tenshu burned 1949 and was rebuilt in concrete 1960; surrounded by 10 000 cherry trees of 250+ varieties – bloom rolls late Apr to m
